review_metadata.scope: Pre-code bounded-contract and testability review only. No implementation, source repair, test changes, release, installation or activation approval.
review_metadata.independence: Reviewer did not author the contract, hardened corpus or production source. Inspected exact frozen-candidate artifacts independently and wrote only this newly authorized verdict.

tools/convergent_review.py bytes equal production base 8e738a038b18c7009018ef771e83aabc23ad9b03; no pre-approval production implementation is present.

evidence: Contract compatibility_and_trust explicitly excludes standalone base-tree mode/base_sha authentication and distinguishes builder provenance from retained packet integrity.
assert_old_git_identity obtains mode, blob OID and exact bytes independently from Git ls-tree/cat-file at the immutable base.

assert_consumer_roundtrip_and_substitution exercises converge and verify-replay, then rejects retained and selected packet substitution.
Contract historical_text_domain defines accepted UTF-8 bytes, nonempty content, 10000000-byte ceiling, ASCII control exclusion, and inert traversal/absolute/drive/backslash text.
Malformed fixtures test empty, invalid UTF-8, NUL, CR/LF, tab, other ASCII controls and DEL.
Exact-limit and oversized fixtures include multibyte UTF-8, distinguishing character count from byte count.
Self-consistent malformed old-link packets exercise the packet-validator boundary separately from the builder.
VERSIONS=(1.0.0,1.1.0,auto) and MODES=(ordinary,full_audit) are applied across applicable fixtures.
assert_valid_packet checks exact effective version, both commit identities, shipped closed JSON Schema and canonical JSON roundtrip.
Contract verification includes tools/test_nf_ac03_binary_review.py alongside existing convergent review, compliance and bootstrap checks.
Consumer/replay roundtrips exercise both review modes and all packet versions; installed v3 consumer acceptance is explicitly limited to 1.0.0.
Added/modified unsafe candidates, escaping-old to safe-new repairs, both link/file directions and identical-byte mode transitions have version/mode matrices.
Unchanged escaping candidate test expressly allows ordinary changed-path scope while requiring full-audit head-tree rejection.
Unsafe renamed destination is rejected; safe rename verifies both changed paths, deleted origin, destination mode, renamed_from and version-specific identity.
Positive hostile text includes HTML-significant characters, Unicode separators and allowed non-ASCII control text, with canonical serialization checks.
Tampering cases cover old content/digest, invalid mode enum, and v1.1 blob OID/byte length; unknown extensions are rejected by the closed schema.
Multi-change fixture compares exact delta and review-files path sets, including full-audit unchanged files.
Worktree drift, direct/ancestor retrieval symlinks, output symlink sentinel preservation and outside FIFO non-access remain executable fixtures.

acceptance_boundary: Approval authorizes implementation only after the independent Evaluator contract-review gate also passes and approval is recorded. Mode B, independently executed QA, evidence capture, applicable high-assurance checks and final-head verification remain required.
